Who You're Talking To

Meet Jenna & Cody

JS

Jenna Swidler

Builder · General Contractor · Storyteller

Jenna turned a SketchUp concept into a real home.

She led the construction of Sustainabox from foundation to finishes, coordinating the build, solving problems as they arose, and documenting every step of the journey. The lessons she captured—the successes, the setbacks, and the countless decisions along the way—are what make every tour and conversation valuable.

If you're thinking about building with containers, Jenna can tell you what actually works, what isn't worth the money, and what she'd do differently after living the experience.

She also leads guest stays, property tours, and behind-the-scenes walkthroughs.

CS

Cody Swidler

Founder · Designer · Systems Thinker

Cody designed Sustainabox, creating the original concept and developing the home in SketchUp long before construction began.

Drawing on a career in enterprise resiliency and risk management, he approached the project the same way he approaches complex systems: research everything, challenge assumptions, and continuously improve the design.

Today, Cody is focused on expanding Sustainabox beyond a single home—building resources, tools, and experiences that help others create smarter container homes while avoiding the mistakes that come with learning everything the hard way.

Common Questions

Before You Reach Out

How do I book a stay?

Reach out with your preferred dates and group size. We'll confirm availability and help you choose the experience that's right for you.

Is the walkthrough included?

Yes. Every stay includes an in-depth walkthrough—either in person with Jenna or as our recorded guided tour when we're traveling.

How many guests can you host?

Our spaces are ideal for 2–4 guests, with accommodations for up to 6 for select group stays.

Is Sustainabox off-grid?

Not today. We're connected to water, septic, and power, but the home was designed around resilient, efficient, and self-sufficient building principles.

Can I bring my own plans or questions?

Absolutely. Whether you have SketchUp files, drawings, photos, or just ideas, we're happy to review them and share what we've learned.

Do you offer consulting?

Yes. We work with aspiring builders around the country through virtual consultations, design reviews, and project guidance—whether or not you stay at Sustainabox.
